column1: # tigerfid reference corpus — the ONE home of the pins (docs/reference-repos.md). kind: tree | file. tree rows: name = the folder recreated from the commit, pin = its full 40-hex commit id, recreated by git archive (node scripts/reference-check.mjs --recreate). file rows: name = <folder>/<path>, pin = sha256 of the bytes, url = the page it was fetched from or - , copy-only (never re-fetched). licence: Apache-2.0 | ActiveWave (the company's own content, not under this repo's licence) | third-party (all rights reserved) | ours. verdict: original | study-only | adopted.
